_rubric: GOOD=player likely cares, non-obvious or quantifies something only vaguely felt, accurate; ACCEPTABLE=true and somewhat interesting but partly known/low magnitude; BORING=true but obvious/so-what/restates result; MISLEADING=wording or fact leads to wrong understanding (outcome contradiction, role-norm, end-push artifact, fake comeback/erosion, overclaim). Rater: research model, single rater, round 1 on audit split (pre-guard definitions).

LANE_DRAMATIC.notes: BLOWOUT dominates (480/540 fires). Separated/reversal full census 40 viewpoints: G0 A16 B23 M1 (LD27 offlaner -1.0k vs carry framed as lost lead). Path-based reversal with meaningful early lead (>=p75) then opposite >=p50: 0/2812 Std, 0/2390 Turbo core lanes.

COMEBACK_WIN.notes: #11 deficit existed only in final minutes of a game the team led (+10k at 30). Won-while-still-behind cases need 'won despite trailing' wording.

LOST_FROM_AHEAD.notes: Some losses while still ahead at end (base race); wording must not say 'the game turned' or 'threw'.

LEAD_FLIP.notes: M: small flip selected while later opposite run decided game (pick latest qualifying flip). A/B: new run is final-push minutes (compute on curve truncated at end-3).

LEAD_ERODED.notes: 43% misleading: relative bands let real gold flips (enemy +8..+21k late) pass as 'eroded'. Guard: -floor <= s*lead(E) <= max(floor, 0.25*peak).

DEFICIT_RECOVERED.notes: Render actual minute values not 3-min medians (#22 said 7.6k where minute value was 13.0k). Same end-state guard as LEAD_ERODED.

CLOSE_MOST_OF_GAME.notes: BORING = short Turbo windows (<=15m) / close share <80%; MISLEADING = close share 62-72% with persistent one-side lead.

EVEN_THEN_SEPARATED.notes: MISL: 'even' period had 8.5-15.8k gaps (late relative bands). BORING: Turbo games <28m (even=laning, then stomp).

LATE_REVERSAL.notes: Almost always co-fires with COMEBACK_WIN (same story).

ENEMY_STACKING.notes: Team-vs-team count; safe if factual (no blame).

ENEMY_SMOKE_VOLUME.notes: BORING when asymmetry small (Std diff<=3) or Turbo 4 vs 2. Guard: diff >=4 Std / >=3 Turbo.

VISION_QUICK_CLEARS.notes: BORING = Turbo count 3 in short stomps. Guard candidate Turbo >=4.

VISION_REGION_SWEEP.notes: BORING = swept wards near natural expiry (median life >180s) or team already >=10k ahead. Guards: median life <=180s; lead at start in (-10k, +10k).

ENEMY_EARLY_ITEM.notes: Pooled-hero p5 flags hero-typical rushes (Invoker/CK Midas, ES blink, Alch/Spectre Radiance, Io/Ogre Aghs). 0-2% margins read as 'normal'. #6 Alchemist Aghanim's may be gifted.

ENEMY_EARLY_RICH.notes: Useful snowball context. BORING: Alchemist (natural farm profile) and 'your team never reached it' in <=15m stomps.

OWN_LANE_VS_USUAL.notes: Contract v1 (bucket+role, last<=50, N>=20, strict best/worst). Supports all ACC (support NW diff is a weaker lane read). Near-tie records (margin <100) read silly.

OWN_ITEM_VS_HISTORY.notes: Slowest records: 12/14 BORING (late situational buys in long games, off-role heroes). Fastest with margin <60s Std/<30s Turbo: BORING/ACC.

OPP_START_VS_HISTORY.notes: Support counterpart NW records mostly ACC/BORING; farming heroes (KotL, NP, Alch, Tinker) inflate CS but claim stays true.
